import io,tarfile,urllib.request,tempfile,pathlib,subprocess,sys
s="8f61233ea953f6f253433cf1fc29313191a6ffa0"
b=urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.github.com/repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/tarball/"+s,timeout=8).read(900001)
assert len(b)<900001
t=tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(b),mode="r:gz")
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="aicore-") as d:
 for m in t.getmembers():
  if not m.isfile():continue
  n=m.name.split("/",1)[-1]
  if not n or ".." in pathlib.PurePosixPath(n).parts:continue
  p=pathlib.Path(d,n);p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(t.extractfile(m).read())
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-q"],cwd=d,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=13)
 print("AI_CORE_FULL_SUITE_EXIT="+str(z.returncode))
 print((z.stdout+z.stderr)[-2800:])
 assert z.returncode==0
